findings.title: The default (lead) view of a session never shows a tool block: tool name, time, cost, rows, the highlighted empty row and the output block only exist inside reader tasks, so the page a user lands on does not look like the spec.
findings.scenario: Start a session from Landing and watch the Session page. The lead stream draws YOU, THINKING, DELEGATED, REPLY and nothing else. SEARCH and RUN appear only after the user clicks a reader in the tree or in the DELEGATED block. The spec (docs/spec #p4) draws SEARCH rows and RUN output in the lead's own stream, between THINKING and DELEGATED.
findings.evidence: /tmp/wf-live/t1.mjs final DOM of the lead: blocks = [you, thinking, delegated|3 in parallel, reply]. GET /api/sessions/<id>: lead steps are thinking, delegate, reply (turn 2: you, thinking, delegate, reply); every 'tool' step has taskId of a reader. Screenshots /tmp/wf-live/t1-turn2.png (lead, no tool block) against /tmp/wf-live/t2-reader.png (reader, SEARCH + RUN).

findings.title: On a second turn the header clock shows a stale value for up to one second, then jumps (observed '1 s RUNNING' for about 0.8 s, then '11 s').
findings.scenario: Session finished at 1 s. Wait about 9 s, say a second turn. root.endedAt goes back to null, the page computes now - startedAt, but `now` still holds the last tick of turn 1 because the interval starts only when `running` turns true and first fires 1000 ms later. The header reads '$0.0300 · 1 s RUNNING', then jumps to '11 s'. The finished header then reads '11 s' for about 2.7 s of work, because the idle time between turns counts. File is not part of this commit; the behaviour shows now because turn 2 is part of the tested flow.
findings.evidence: t1.mjs turn-2 timeline: i=0 '$0.0300 · 1 sdone'; i=1..4 '$0.0300 · 1 srunning'; i=5 '$0.0400 · 11 srunning'; i=7 '11 sdone'. API: lead startedAt 0, endedAt 10801 ms; second reader 9943..10794. Code: `const timer = window.setInterval(() => setNow(Date.now()), 1000)` with no setNow at the moment running becomes true.

findings.title: Opening a delegated child with Enter drops keyboard focus to <body>, because the button that had focus is unmounted when the stream switches task.
findings.scenario: Tab to the first row of a DELEGATED block (5th Tab stop), press Enter. The reader's stream draws correctly, but document.activeElement is BODY. A screen-reader user gets no announcement of the change and loses the place; the tree row of the opened task does not receive focus.
findings.evidence: t3.mjs: "Enter on delegated child -> [ 'to reader', 'search', 'run', 'reply' ] focus now: BODY". Tab order recorded: 4 nav links, delegated children, input[say], Send, tree rows, findings. Focus ring is visible (screenshot /tmp/wf-live/t3-focus-child.png).

findings.title: The new receipt (time and cost) and the tool name use text-faint at 12 px, which measures 3.45:1 on the dark card and 3.04:1 on the light card, under the 4.5:1 AA threshold for small text.
findings.scenario: Reader view, SEARCH block: '403 MS · $0.0100' and 'SEARCH' are rgb(103,113,124) on rgb(22,28,35) in dark; rgb(139,149,161) on white in light (html.dark removed). The cost of a step is money information; it is the least readable text in the block. The token is older than this commit; the commit puts new information in it. The source chip of a non-empty row uses the same colour.
findings.evidence: t4.mjs / t5.mjs computed contrast: '3.45 rgb(103, 113, 124) on 22,28,35 "search" 12px'; light: '3.04 rgb(139, 149, 161) on 255,255,255 "search" 12px'. All other text is 5.4:1 or more; the highlighted empty row (text-decide) is 7.54:1 dark, 5.59:1 light.

findings.title: prefers-color-scheme: light has no effect: the app stays dark (html class="dark" is fixed). Not a defect of this branch; the light theme could be tested only by removing the class by hand.
findings.scenario: Emulate prefers-color-scheme light at 390 px: body background stays rgb(15,19,24). docs/UI.md says 'Dark by default', so this is by agreement. With .dark removed the Session page draws correctly in light: surfaces, sunken output block, amber empty row all switch through theme tokens.
findings.evidence: t4.mjs: matchMedia light = true, bodyBg 'rgb(15, 19, 24)'. theme.css has no prefers-color-scheme rule, only `.dark {`. Screenshots /tmp/wf-live/t5-light-wide.png and /tmp/wf-live/t5-light-narrow.png.

findings.title: Remaining visible differences from spec page 04, most important first.
findings.scenario: Compared /tmp/wf-live/t1-turn2.png and /tmp/wf-live/t2-reader.png with /tmp/wf-live/t5-spec.png (1500 px). (1) Lead stream has no SEARCH/RUN blocks (see first finding). (2) Spec SEARCH has no body line: label, receipt, then rows. App draws the step text '"..." (demo, no network)' and then rows that repeat the same long title, so the block is three times as tall; spec rows are one short line each (source chip, query, result). (3) Spec has SAVE and RECORD blocks ('TOOL CALL' at the right, FILE chip with '+28', FINDING rows with confirmed/open); the app has no such block, and a reader's recorded finding does not appear in its stream. (4) FINDINGS panel: spec gives each finding a status chip (DROPPED / CONFIRMED / OPEN) and a short text; app shows the agent name 'READER' as the eyebrow and no status. (5) Spec right column is one flat panel joined to the stream and divided by rules, inside one frame with a fixed height and the composer pinned; app uses three separate rounded cards with gaps and the page grows with the stream. (6) Spec composer is one bordered box with '+' inside and a filled primary send arrow; app has a ghost '+', a separate input and a ghost send icon. (7) Money: spec '$0.01' and '$0.94'; app '$0.0100', '$0.0300'. (8) Sub-second time reads '403 MS' because the eyebrow uppercases it; spec only shows seconds ('6 S', '8.9 S'), so this shows only with the demo pace. (9) Spec header carries the account badge and the title inside the top bar; app has the title under the nav. Items 4, 5, 6, 9 are older than this commit.
findings.evidence: Spec text dump from #p4 (t6.mjs): 'SEARCH / 6 S · $0.01 / ARXIV / permutation statistics · last 6 months / 41 papers ... OEIS / pop-stack preimages / nothing', 'SAVE / TOOL CALL / FILE / code/popstack.py / +28', 'RECORD / TOOL CALL / FINDING ... confirmed'. App DOM (t2.mjs): eyebrows ['search','403 ms · $0.0100'], body '"what is already known: ..." (demo, no network)', rows 'demo | what is already known: ... | 3 sources'.

findings.title: The demo session finishes in about 1.3 to 1.5 s, not 'a few seconds', so a reader's live steps can be watched only if the user clicks a reader within about half a second.
findings.scenario: Lead: thinking and delegate arrive within 570 ms of submit; three readers run in parallel, each with two 400 ms tool steps; lead replies at about 1.45 s. The 'watch it work' effect of the branch is mostly invisible on the lead view: the only live change there is the three statuses going queued -> running -> done. A tool step is drawn only when it finishes, so a running reader shows 'Nothing yet.' for 400 ms and no sign of what it is doing.
findings.evidence: t2.mjs timeline: 575 ms ['to reader',''] ; 1044 ms + 'search|403 ms · $0.0100' ; 1451 ms + 'run|401 ms','reply' and header DONE. API task times: readers 424..1320 ms, lead ended about 1.4 s.

checked_and_fine: 1 LIVE: steps arrive one after another, not in one batch. Lead: you+thinking at 363 ms, delegated at 565 ms, reply at 1579 ms. Reader (clicked at 574 ms): search at 1044 ms, run+reply at 1451 ms (t1.mjs, t2.mjs, 100-200 ms polling).
1 LIVE: header cost rises live ($0.0000 -> $0.0300 at about 1.1 s), clock ticks 0 s -> 1 s, status word goes RUNNING -> DONE; tree statuses go queued -> running -> done.

1 Tool block draws all parts: name from detail.tool (SEARCH, RUN), '403 ms · $0.0100' receipt (RUN shows time only, it has no cost), 2 rows with source chip / query / result, the empty row highlighted (chip border and text rgb(213,164,71) = text-decide, result 'nothing' in the same colour; the other row is faint/muted), and the output in a <pre> on bg-sunken with the 3 lines intact.

Money: header $0.0300 equals API spend.dollars 0.03 and the sum of three $0.0100 search costs; after turn 2 $0.0400 equals API 0.04; totals[lead]=0.04, lead ownCost 0. The page displays server numbers; no sum in the browser was observed.

2 DELEGATED: first delegate step lists exactly 3 children, second turn's step lists exactly 1 (the new reader); turn 1's block stays at 3. API detail.childTaskIds matches the rows by count and order. Statuses update live in the block: [running,queued,queued] -> [running x3] -> [done x3]; turn 2: [running] -> [done].

3 RELOAD MID-RUN (reload at 754 ms, session still running; 1.5 s would be after the end because a session lasts about 1.4 s): first draw after reload at 893 ms showed you/thinking/delegated and running tree; after the end every task's blocks match GET /api/sessions/<id> exactly once, in index order [0,1,2] per task, with labels, rows, output, duration, cost, child count. Repeated with a reload 500 ms into turn 2: also matches; findings 4 of 4 drawn, no duplicate.

4 LATE TAB: a second tab opened after the end draws the same DOM for all 5 tasks as the live tab (string-equal), header '$0.0400 · 6 s DONE' in both, detail included. Deep link ?session=<id>&task=<reader> opens the reader stream with search and run blocks.

5 SECOND ACCOUNT: page shows only 'no such session' plus the empty-state card; no title, step, reader or finding text (regex leak check false; screenshot /tmp/wf-live/t3-intruder.png). GET /api/sessions/<id>, /api/projects/<pid>, /api/projects/<pid>/findings all 404 for the intruder. Over /ws, session.open returns {type:'error',message:'no such session'}; a session.say from the intruder did not reach the owner's page. A signed-out visitor sees 'sign in first' and no content.

6 NARROW 390 px: documentElement.scrollWidth 390 = clientWidth on lead and reader views, no element past the right edge; the grid stacks stream, call tree, findings. The output <pre> has overflow-x auto with scrollWidth 385 > clientWidth 308, so it scrolls inside itself and does not widen the page. Long titles wrap. Same result with the light theme forced.
6 Contrast: everything except text-faint is 5.4:1 or better in dark and light; output block text 9.97:1 dark, 11.11:1 light.

7 KEYBOARD: Tab reaches delegated children (stop 5 on), then input, Send, the tree rows, the findings; all are real <button>s with a visible focus ring. Enter on a delegated child opens that reader's stream; Enter on a tree row opens that task.

8 CONSOLE / NETWORK across all runs: the only error for the owner is the /favicon.ico 404. One 'GET /api/me net::ERR_ABORTED' came from my own page.reload() and is not an app fault. No pageerror, no React warning, no failed request. The intruder's 404s are the intended answers.
UI rules on the rendered page: 0 elements with an inline style attribute inside <main>; colours resolve from theme tokens and switch correctly when .dark is removed.
